question: For what duration of practice is the destruction of old age and death said to follow?
premises: A duration of one year is specified.
That duration is the time for which the practice is done.
When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
inference: Practice sustained for one year results in the destruction of old age and death.
uncertainties: The practice referred to is the one prescribed in the preceding verses.
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
